text:
Sam: quick sync on the tenant-gated rollout for AcmeCorp + two partners. goal: predictable ramp, per-tenant schedules, and clear fallback ordering.

Talia: propose micro-stages to reduce blast: 1% -> 5% -> 15% -> 40%. hold 45m min at each stage unless we see green signals.

Umar: telemetry gates: p95 latency delta, p99 tail delta, 5xx delta, and a small quality check on golden prompts. cost delta is a soft gate.

Vik: fallback chain suggestion: (a) fast quantized variant in-region, (b) hot-standby region, (c) cached prefix responses, (d) polite degrade with retry token. log fallback_reason and step.

Winnie: UX: per-tenant schedule in Console with timezone-aware windows and an "office-hours only" toggle. email at stage start/advance/rollback. include single-click rollback link.

Sam: engineering constraints: pre-warm caches and KV before advancing. cap rolling restarts to 5% of pools. reserve a 12% buffer for the canary pool.

Talia: acceptance criteria: no p95 regression > 120ms, 5xx +0.4pp, and no golden-set regression > 1.5% over 30m. if any fail -> auto-throttle to 0 + page SRE.

Umar: implement shadow A/B only for tenants that opt-in. otherwise keep single-variant path. sample 0.5% of requests for offline eval, store for 10d.

Vik: add cost hysteresis: if cost/token > 30% for 20m, reduce fraction by 50% and mark soft-fail.

Winnie: ops: provide standard email templates and a tiny dashboard tile (p95, 5xx, eval-fail, cost-delta). I'll draft emails.

Sam: rollout service: single rollout_id, tenant whitelist + schedule map, plus an always-skip list. avoid per-tenant flags.

rollout-bot: preflight: capacity ok in us-east-1 for stage-1. scheduled start 2025-10-02T15:00Z. will post reminder 10m prior.

Talia: also require two green telemetry cycles before advancing. define green cycle = all gates within thresholds for a 15m window.

Umar: instrumentation: tag rollout_id, tenant_id, cohort. emit rollout.stage.change and rollout.fallback.count(reason). trace sampled requests to link to logs.

Vik: ops checklist: prewarm, reserve capacity, smoke synthetic traffic, monitor tail histograms.

Sam: decision summary: micro-staged tenant canary; cohort-based flag; shadow A/B opt-in; clear fallback chain; hold windows + green cycles; Console schedule + emails; kill-switch Console+API. I'll put this in the PRD.

Winnie: I'll add the email + dashboard mocks to the spec by EOD today.

Umar: will add exact alert rules and thresholds.

Talia: will draft the rollout policy YAML for the engineering team.

rollout-bot: reminder: preflight notice will be sent to #product 2025-10-02T14:50Z.
